detail.longDescription: The # CfP deadline for # KubeCon + # CloudNativeCon EU 2027 is today! This year I’m going in with two # Nix -flavored takes on supply-chain transparency: One for the # Security track: # CRA compliance as a build byproduct, with # SBOMs derived from # Nix . One for # PlatformEngineering : reproducible builds as the source of truth for # Kubernetes workloads. See you in Barcelona!
